snippet.title: Scattered - Gameplay Trailer - A New Cat Adventure Coming Soon to Steam!
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4305820

More from HAELE 3D: https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/haele3d

Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of lost kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home. 

Developers: Ige Olwen, Sala Cruz
Publisher: HAELE 3D
Music: Mate Maklary
